threads.title: Who was at the 589 Pollino storm?
threads.reader_question: Who is the scarred man glimpsed during the 589 storm, and why does his presence matter to Luca's 789 discovery?
threads.purpose: Establish a controlled origin fragment without disclosing Farovald's age, longevity, later identities, or full biological connection.
threads.next_reveal: Show only the mature pine, violent storm, a human figure in contact with Italus, scorched palms, resin/cambium injury, and immediate sensory aftermath; return to 789 before explaining what the event did to the man.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not state Farovald's age, full lifespan, immortality, later aliases, later guardian interventions, or final fate. Do not call him a guardian.

threads.title: Why does Farovald physically react when Italus is stressed?
threads.reader_question: Is the monk merely observant, or is his body physically linked to Italus?
threads.purpose: Advance the mystery from unusual knowledge to a bounded physiological connection without revealing the full 589 mechanism.
threads.next_reveal: In a mid-Book-1 chapter, show Farovald experiencing a localized palm/nerve response that correlates with a major Italus root-pressure or resin-temperature change before he can physically inspect the tree.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not describe telepathy, language, remote sight, prophecy, or the complete 589 biological mechanism. Do not disclose his total age.

threads.title: Why has Farovald barely aged while Luca has?
threads.reader_question: How can the same monk look almost unchanged decades after Luca first met him?
threads.purpose: Make Farovald's abnormal longevity undeniable late in Book 1 while preserving the deeper mechanism and future history.
threads.next_reveal: Place the reveal after enough mainline time has passed for Luca to show unmistakable aging; Farovald's face and lightning-scarred hands remain recognizably unchanged.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not move this reveal to 810; Luca is only about thirty-five then. Do not disclose Farovald's later aliases, full lifespan, or final-series resolution.

threads.title: What is Farovald's place beside the guardian line?
threads.reader_question: If Farovald is not a guardian, why does he keep returning to Luca and Italus?
threads.purpose: Close Book 1 by naming Farovald, confirming the 589 connection and defining his non-lineage perimeter role without exposing later-book identities or final fate.
threads.next_reveal: Near the Book-1 resolution, disclose Farovald's name, that he was directly altered in the 589 event, and that he will watch the wider secrecy perimeter while Luca's family carries guardianship.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not make Farovald Guardian Zero, a succession authority, or the inventor of the entire guardian doctrine. Do not reveal later aliases or final fate.

threads.title: Which later stranger is Farovald?
threads.reader_question: Has the apparently ordinary monk, archivist, traveler, or warden appeared in another century under a different identity?
threads.purpose: Let the author decide when a later guardian or reader recognizes Farovald under a period-appropriate cover identity.
threads.next_reveal: Introduce one era-appropriate cover identity naturally, then reveal only the next justified physical or behavioral marker that links the person back to Farovald.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not preload all future aliases into prose. Do not reveal every historical intervention or his final fate when a single returning identity is enough.

threads.title: Who left Anselm the coded botanical folio?
threads.reader_question: Is the archive folio merely an old monastic note, or a deliberately planted continuity cache connected to Farovald?
threads.purpose: Let the author introduce the first explicit later-era Farovald dead drop without forcing immediate recognition of his identity.
threads.next_reveal: Reveal the physical folio and one bounded route/record-gap clue first. Farovald's authorship can remain uncertain until the chapter has earned the connection.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not reveal future dead drops, Farovald's complete chronology, or knowledge later than 1054. Do not let the folio solve every missing guardian record.

threads.title: Who prepared Pietro's 1527 fallback route packet?
threads.reader_question: Why does a sealed route packet anticipate exactly the roads Pietro can still use after the Sack of Rome?
threads.purpose: Use Farovald's indirect assistance to preserve route continuity while keeping the destroyed journal genuinely lost.
threads.next_reveal: Show the waxed-linen packet, route strip, and safe-water annotations. Reveal authorship only when a physical/behavioral marker justifies the connection.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not recreate the lost journal in full, predict the Sack, or expose later Farovald identities.

threads.title: Who left Agata the paper-life continuity packet?
threads.reader_question: Why does the packet understand the identity risks created by increasingly persistent government records?
threads.purpose: Introduce Farovald's accumulated administrative experience as bounded evidence that helps Agata adapt without importing later-century knowledge.
threads.next_reveal: Expose one or two era-correct observations about surname repetition, inheritance papers, or archive jurisdictions before confirming the packet's source.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not use 19th/20th-century identity techniques in 1789, predict later governments, or make Farovald an omniscient planner.

threads.title: Who prepared Theodora's 1940 Pollino contingency cache?
threads.reader_question: Who anticipated the routes, compromised roads, and surviving record location that Theodora needs during the wartime handoff?
threads.purpose: Provide a bounded wartime continuity bridge after Rosa's death while preserving destroyed-record consequences.
threads.next_reveal: Show the oilcloth/metal cache, maps, and one surviving-record pointer. Let the author decide when the Farovald connection becomes explicit.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not restore destroyed records, disclose Farovald's final fate, or include post-1940 knowledge.

threads.title: Why does the Final Guardian receive an analog fallback cache?
threads.reader_question: Why has Farovald deliberately chosen physical maps and offline verification as digital records and mapping become more persistent?
threads.purpose: Turn the transition toward persistent digital records and mapping into a concrete continuity problem without revealing Farovald's final resolution.
threads.next_reveal: Reveal the analog fallback materials and the warning about repeated physical/digital patterns. Keep Farovald's endpoint separate behind the final-resolution thread.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not predict specific future platforms, expose the final-resolution mechanism, or imply the cache appoints the Final Guardian.

threads.title: How does Farovald's long life finally end?
threads.reader_question: What biological limit finally closes Farovald's deep-time witness?
threads.purpose: Reserve Farovald's final resolution for Book 11 so Book 1 and intermediate books cannot automatically expose it.
threads.next_reveal: Do not define the final mechanism until Book 11 planning. Resolve it there against the then-current World Canon and the accumulated evidence established in prior books.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: No Book 1–10 chapter may state Farovald's exact endpoint, exact final mechanism, or a literal time-travel outcome as settled Canon.

threads.title: Who succeeds the family lineage?
threads.reader_question: Who will inherit the family-line guardianship after Marco?
threads.purpose: Introduce Simonetta as a person before the reader is told that she is the next guardian, then let preparation and observation establish her significance.
threads.next_reveal: Advance only the next justified clue about Simonetta's preparation or succession significance; do not jump directly to the full handoff unless prior prose has earned it.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not state Simonetta's complete guardian destiny before the approved succession reveal point.

threads.title: Anselm detects missing knowledge
threads.reader_question: What has the guardian line forgotten or transmitted inconsistently?
threads.purpose: Turn the move from oral transmission to encoded records into a mystery about missing, inconsistent, or fragile knowledge.
threads.next_reveal: Show Anselm noticing a specific inconsistency or gap before revealing his decision to encode what survives.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not present the later guardian record tradition as complete or already systematized.

threads.title: Why is Caterina interested in Amara?
threads.reader_question: Why is a court translator/document secretary becoming important to Caterina?
threads.purpose: Let Amara first function naturally in the court world, then gradually disclose that Caterina is evaluating her for a much larger responsibility.
threads.next_reveal: Reveal one additional reason Caterina trusts or evaluates Amara without yet making the full succession outcome obvious.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not identify Amara as the next guardian at her first appearance.

threads.title: Lost or degraded guardian record during plague
threads.reader_question: What information disappeared during the plague years?
threads.purpose: Create a record-loss thread whose missing meaning can be recovered or inferred by later guardians.
threads.next_reveal: Establish the loss, damage, or incompleteness without immediately explaining everything the missing record contained.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not reconstruct the complete missing content in the same beat that establishes the loss.

threads.title: Sack of Rome lost journal
threads.reader_question: Which guardian knowledge was destroyed in 1527, and what survives elsewhere?
threads.purpose: Use the canon-supported journal destruction to create a cross-book information gap rather than a disposable historical detail.
threads.next_reveal: Show evidence of the journal's destruction or absence and preserve uncertainty about the unique information it contained.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not let another intact record conveniently reproduce the destroyed journal in full.

threads.title: Galileo and Domenico's record doubt
threads.reader_question: If public knowledge can be forced, edited, or suppressed, how trustworthy are the guardian records?
threads.purpose: Use Galileo's forced recantation as an intellectual parallel that makes Domenico question transmission, suppression, and interpretation without changing Galileo's history.
threads.next_reveal: Let Domenico connect the trial to a specific doubt about guardian records or inherited interpretation, while keeping the historical outcome immutable.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not imply that Domenico changes Galileo's trial or possesses hidden proof that alters recorded history.

threads.title: Emilio's identity-paper mystery
threads.reader_question: How can a long-lived guardian survive increasingly persistent identity records?
threads.purpose: Turn administrative modernization and longevity into an escalating identity-management problem.
threads.next_reveal: Expose one documentary inconsistency, repeated identity pattern, or paper trail that forces Emilio to adapt.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not let modern records publicly prove the guardian longevity mechanism or Italus's secret.

threads.title: Serra, Rosa, and the Pollino secret
threads.reader_question: What has Domenico Serra noticed, and how much does Rosa trust him to understand?
threads.purpose: Use Serra's bounded knowledge progression to bridge Rosa and Theodora without turning Serra into a guardian or giving him the complete secret.
threads.next_reveal: Advance Serra only one knowledge step supported by prior prose: suspicion, recognition of a Pollino-linked responsibility, or the need for succession.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not give Serra full mobility, resin, signal-system, route, decoding-key, or complete guardian-record knowledge.

threads.title: WWII destroyed guardian record
threads.reader_question: What continuity knowledge was lost during the war?
threads.purpose: Create a second canon-supported information-loss point that compounds earlier fragmentation and matters to the final consolidation arc.
threads.next_reveal: Establish which record or collection is gone or inaccessible without immediately solving the resulting knowledge gap.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not make the loss narratively meaningless by preserving an exact duplicate elsewhere.

threads.title: The unnamed future guardian
threads.reader_question: Which apparently ordinary person will become the Final Guardian?
threads.purpose: Introduce the eventual Final Guardian before formally identifying their narrative importance.
threads.next_reveal: Show the future guardian in an ordinary or secondary role and reveal only the next justified sign of Theodora's interest or preparation.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not identify the person's full future significance until the author-approved succession point.

threads.title: The scattered record consolidation
threads.reader_question: What does the surviving guardian record reveal only when its scattered pieces are brought together?
threads.purpose: Use notebooks, monastery holdings, family collections, lost maps, and incomplete records as the series-level mystery spine.
threads.next_reveal: Recover or correlate one additional piece and show what new question or partial answer it creates; preserve the fact that no single historical record was complete.
threads.forbidden_early_disclosure: Do not collapse the fragmented tradition into one previously complete master record.
